source:
@@U04079@@
Yes, well, time will tell. Though I can’t say I favor this semi-retreat.

@@U04081@@
Look there at our right flank, Sire. We couldn't ask for better fighting terrain. Slopes neither too steep nor too accessible, an advantage for us, a stumbling block for the enemy. Besides, we're half-hidden on a rolling plain; their cavalry won't even attempt it.

@@U04083@@
I can only approve. Today we test our strength as well as loyalty.

@@U04085@@
Look at our phalanx. Do you see? On the flat central meadow? They couldn't be in better fighting spirit, their pikes flashing through the sunny morning mist. In that vast, dark, heaving square thousands of warriors are straining at the leash, aflame to do great deeds. You can feel their strength from here. I assure you, Majesty, they'll break the enemy’s back.

@@U04087@@
I've never seen a finer sight. Such an army is worth one twice its size.

@@U04089@@
The left flank speaks for itself. The rocky cliffs are well fortified with men; you can see their flashing arms from here. They'll cover the crucial pass into the valley.
translation:
@@U04079@@
是的，好吧，时间会证明一切。虽然我不能说我喜欢这种半撤退。

@@U04081@@
看看我们的右翼，陛下。我们不能要求更好的战斗地形了。斜坡既不太陡，也不太容易接近，对我们来说是优势，对敌人来说是绊脚石。此外，我们半隐藏在连绵起伏的平原上；他们的骑兵甚至不会尝试。

@@U04083@@
我只能赞同。今天我们测试我们的实力和忠诚度。

@@U04085@@
看看我们的方阵。你看到了吗？在平坦的中央草地上？他们的战斗精神再好不过了，他们的长矛在阳光明媚的晨雾中闪闪发光。在那片广阔、黑暗、起伏的广场上，成千上万的战士正在竭尽全力，燃烧着做出伟大事业的火焰。从这里你可以感受到他们的力量。我向您保证，陛下，他们会折断敌人的后背。

@@U04087@@
我从未见过如此美妙的景象。这样一支军队的价值是其规模的两倍。

@@U04089@@
左翼不言而喻。岩石峭壁上有坚固的人手；从这里你可以看到他们闪烁的手臂。他们将覆盖进入山谷的关键通道。
